tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje phur pa'i tshe 'gugs pa'i sbyor ra bzhugs so:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ shrī ku mā ra la na mo:

rdo rje phur pa'i tshe 'gugs cho ga gsang ba lag len 'di la gsum ste: sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes rim mo: tshe 'gugs pa'i sbyor ba ni: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lhar: tshe'i dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni: gangs rgyud ma chad pa'i ri bkra shis pa'i ri'i sa la: dkyil 'khor khru gang gru bzhi pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po bris pa'i lte bar: rdza bum sos smin pa dkar pos byugs pa'i nang du: chu 'dus chu gtsang ba'i chus bsings pa'i chang la bdud rtsi btab: 'bri lo bcu'am bdun lon pa'i mar ril mched tsho dang grangs mnyam pa sgrubs: rgad po bkra shis pa lo brgyad cu tsam lon pa las blangs pa'i nas la phye byas pa'i tshe'i 'brang rgyas zlum brjid kyis kha bcad: tshe'i mda' dar gzug: gzungs thag dkar po btags te tshe phur la gtod do: dngos ni: bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum srung mar bcas pa'i thugs dam bskul: 'od zer sna tshogs lcags 'dra ba'i pho nya spros: phyogs bcur khyab: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang: steng lha: 'og klu: bar mi: phyi snod: nang bcud: thams cad kyi dngos grub tshe'i rang bzhin bdud rtsir bkug la: bum pa bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang rdo rje'i gur chen du dkyil bar bsam zhing: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes khro bcu sras mchog srung ma thams cad kyi sngags sham du sbyar te: bzlas pa brgya stong ci 'grub tu bya'o: de nas pho nya bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rjes 'od 'phros tshe 'gugs lha: khro rgyal yab yum sras 'khor bcas: tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ kār sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod:

dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa yi mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'dod rgyal mda' snyems spyang ki khra yi mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seṅge pha wang mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: khams gsum gsod byed dom dang sre mong mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: stobs chen bskyod byed dred dang byi ba'i mgo: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog kī la ya: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhis: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma ltar byams mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ dza dza: zhes mda' dar g.yab la bum par bstim mo: rjes la tshe bstim pa ni: tshe bum dang bcas pa bteg ste spyi bor bzhag la: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra ā yu she a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dza: kā ya ā yu she oṃ: wā ka ā yu she ā: tsit+ta ā yu she hūm̐: zhes gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs tshe yi dngos grub bstim zhing dbang bskur: bdud rtsi 'thung: tshe mar spyi gtsug tu byugs: lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin cis kyang mi shigs par bsam: ngag grags stong kī la yar grags par bsam: yid stong gsal g.yung drung klong du gsal: bla mas me tog gtor: rab gnas bya: bkra shis gsol: tshe zan g.yas su kham kham za: chang g.yon skor du hub hub btung: tshe mdud lan gsum du byung na tshe'i dngos grub thob bo:
